gate_2_reference: evidence/gate-2.json (decision: NOT_RUN; no dedicated M1 target exists)

decision.scope: Prototype VM images and the native prototype image plan only; the physical M1 disk arrangement is explicitly undecided and hardware-gated
rationale: ext4 is the only candidate with a source-built ARM64 kext in this repository (evidence/kernel/kexts/result.json) and an actual mounted, writable root in the QEMU VIRT guest (/dev/disk0s2, docs/virtualization.md)
Existing image tooling (scripts/vm/assemble.py, vm/smoke-image.nix) already produces and audits GPT + FAT ESP + ext4 images; no new formatter or provenance path is needed
The pinned loader's ramdisk loading is commented out, so a block-device root is required regardless of filesystem choice (docs/virtualization.md)
HFS+ kernel source exists only as an Apple-derived APSL-2.0 core in the PureDarwin tree and is not built or validated here; the pinned modern xnu-12377.121.6 contains no bsd/hfs implementation
Apple's APFS kernel driver is not available as source in any pinned input; the PureDarwin apfs directory is an incomplete version-0.1 scaffold, not a usable filesystem
revisit_triggers: Physical M1 experiments show iBoot/LocalPolicy requires the custom OS root inside an APFS container or volume group
A source-available, reviewable APFS or HFS+ implementation reaches build and mount validation in this repository
Gate 2 (independent physical boot) evidence identifies a concrete filesystem-related blocker

candidates.name: ext4
candidates.license: PureDarwin BSD-style license (PUREDARWIN_LICENSE.txt); driver sources carry no Apple APSL header
candidates.source_state: Read-write driver: extent-based inodes, 32/64-bit block numbers, metadata_csum maintenance, JBD2 journaling with replay on mount (ext4.h header)
repo_evidence: evidence/kernel/kexts/result.json: built as Mach-O arm64 kext (status built-not-boot-validated at that checkpoint)
evidence/kernel/kexts/command.json: ext4.kext and Ext4FileSystemDriver in the VM kernel extension set
docs/virtualization.md: actual guest mounted a genuine ext4 root as /dev/disk0s2 and retained writes in a private disk copy; v11 guest passed PID 1/shell/runtime/network checks
candidates.validation_scope: QEMU VIRT guest only; no physical M1 storage driver exists

candidates.name: hfs+
candidates.license: APSL-2.0 (Apple copyright 1999-2017 headers in core sources); redistribution requires notice retention per sources.lock.json conventions
candidates.source_state: Apple-derived HFS+ core (BTree, catalog, extents) with a PureDarwin shim and hfs_encodings; not in the built kext set (absent from evidence/kernel/kexts/command.json)
repo_evidence: Pinned modern xnu-12377.121.6 (ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f) has no bsd/hfs directory; only miscfs, vfs infrastructure and an NFS client ship in the modern open-source kernel
No source-built HFS+ formatting or fsck tooling exists in this repository; scripts/vm/assemble.py uses mke2fs/debugfs only
candidates.validation_scope: none; not compiled, mounted or booted in this repository

candidates.name: apfs-apple
candidates.license: Proprietary; Apple's APFS kernel driver is not published in any pinned open-source input
candidates.source_state: No APFS implementation in pinned xnu-12377.121.6; APFS-related strings in bsd/vfs are VFS-layer integration points, not a filesystem implementation
repo_evidence: docs/platform/native-boot.md: LocalPolicy vuid identifies the selected APFS volume group, so APFS remains a boot-policy/container concern even though it cannot be a source-built kernel filesystem
candidates.validation_scope: none; cannot be built from audited source

candidates.name: apfs-puredarwin-scaffold
candidates.license: PureDarwin-authored scaffold (apfs.h bears no Apple header)
candidates.source_state: Approximately 3100 lines: container/volume structures, B-tree reader and mount path; mount logs 'mounted scaffold read-write'; apfs_parse_disk_minor returns ENOTSUP for any disk other than disk0; not in the built kext set
repo_evidence: Not listed in evidence/kernel/kexts/command.json; never compiled or mounted by this repository's CI or guest

candidates.name: msdosfs
candidates.source_state: FAT filesystem; the assembled image's ESP is FAT32 (mkfs.fat in scripts/vm/assemble.py) and is a boot-asset partition, not a candidate server root
candidates.validation_scope: ESP creation is exercised by the image pipeline; no guest ESP mount requirement is established

apple_silicon_constraints.constraint: Apple Silicon applies a per-installed-OS LocalPolicy; booting a custom XNU requires Permissive Security, set in paired 1TR with machine-owner authorization, and signatures remain checked in the boot chain
apple_silicon_constraints.basis: Apple Platform Security references cited in docs/platform/native-boot.md; no project experiment has executed a policy change

apple_silicon_constraints.constraint: LocalPolicy field vuid identifies the selected APFS volume group; boot policy on internal storage is therefore bound to APFS volume-group identity
apple_silicon_constraints.basis: Apple LocalPolicy field documentation cited in docs/platform/native-boot.md; volume-group capture is part of the m1-lab runbook but has never been performed

apple_silicon_constraints.constraint: kmutil configure-boot is recovery-only and targets a selected system --volume; LocalPolicy coih is a SHA384 of the CustomOS Image4 manifest, distinct from file-level SHA256 hashes
apple_silicon_constraints.basis: Read-only inspection of the installed kmutil.8 man page and kmutil help on the Mac15,8 build host (docs/platform/native-boot.md); host tooling does not establish target recovery compatibility

apple_silicon_constraints.constraint: macOS system volumes on Apple Silicon use a sealed (signed) system volume inside an APFS container; blauOS adopts an immutable system with separate writable data as its intended image model, with APFS containers, boot policy, authorized assets and recoverability determining the eventual disk arrangement
apple_silicon_constraints.basis: docs/scope.md release-contract language; docs/platform/native-boot.md forbids importing SSV-downgrade steps from unrelated recipes without an observed failure

apple_silicon_constraints.constraint: A block-device root is required for the current prototype: the pinned loader's load_ramdisk calls are commented out, so an rd=md0 ramdisk root cannot be accepted as working
apple_silicon_constraints.basis: docs/virtualization.md records the loader source inspection and the selection of image-arm64-virt-minimal-release with an ordinary ext4 root

apple_silicon_constraints.constraint: A source-built XNU kernel with the source-built ext4 kext mounts a GPT ext4 partition as root (/dev/disk0s2), supports writes retained across a guest session, and carries a passing PID 1/shell/runtime/network guest run
apple_silicon_constraints.basis: docs/virtualization.md v11 guest narrative and evidence/virtualization/pid1-checkpoint receipts; image assembled by scripts/vm/assemble.py with mke2fs and inode metadata verified via debugfs
apple_silicon_constraints.validation_scope: virtual (QEMU VIRT) only; not evidence for any physical platform

apple_silicon_constraints.constraint: Whether iBoot/LocalPolicy requires a custom OS root filesystem to reside inside an APFS container or APFS volume group on internal ANS storage, or permits a non-APFS partition as root alongside an authorized custom boot object
apple_silicon_constraints.basis: No physical M1 exists in the project (evidence/gate-2.json decision NOT_RUN); this can only be resolved by a target experiment with preserved pre/post policy captures

apple_silicon_constraints.constraint: Mounting any root filesystem on physical M1 internal storage requires ANS NVMe and DART/DMA drivers, which are P1 work and have no source implementation or physical validation in this repository
apple_silicon_constraints.basis: docs/scope.md places DART/DMA and ANS/storage in P1; docs/audits/source-dependencies.md blocker HW-001 states QEMU VIRT support does not provide M1 support

apple_silicon_constraints.constraint: Actual APFS container behavior on a physical M1 (container/volume creation for a custom OS, sealed-system implications for a non-macOS root, and recoverability of the disk arrangement after experiments)
apple_silicon_constraints.basis: Requires the dedicated Macmini9,1 lab, recovery operator and reversal procedure from docs/platform/m1-lab.md and docs/platform/native-boot.md; none verified

current.layout: GPT disk: partition 1 FAT32 ESP (type EF00, EFI/BOOT/BOOTAA64.EFI loader, kernel, boot-args.txt); partition 2 ext4 root (label blauos-root, deterministic uuid5 disk/root/ESP UUIDs derived from kernel+loader+provenance SHA256 digests)
tooling: scripts/vm/assemble.py: audits the staged Mach-O closure, formats GPT/FAT/ext4 in Linux, verifies account inode metadata via debugfs, emits result.json with image and input hashes
vm/smoke-image.nix: wraps the pinned upstream image-arm64-virt-minimal-release (ordinary ext4 root) and injects source-built probes with a runtime-provenance.json receipt
scripts/vm/extract_core.py: read-only debugfs extraction of guest artifacts for diagnostics
current.status: validated in the QEMU VIRT guest (FS-C6)

next_steps.step: Split the single ext4 root into an immutable ext4 system partition mounted read-only plus a separate writable ext4 data partition for /var and service state, matching the docs/scope.md immutable-system model
next_steps.status: planned-not-validated; requires assemble.py layout changes and a guest remount/rw-guard proof before it can be claimed

next_steps.step: Keep the ESP content contract (loader, kernel, boot-args.txt) unchanged so existing collection/provenance tooling continues to bind image hashes

Defer the physical M1 disk arrangement (APFS container questions, boot-policy binding, authorized assets, reversal) until the lab prerequisites in docs/platform/m1-lab.md are met; candidate arrangements include a non-APFS ext4 root if firmware permits, or APFS-hosted boot assets with separate data volumes, but both are unvalidated
